# Database changes — Oct 19 sprint

**Migration:** `prisma/migrations/20261019190000_lifecycle_records/migration.sql` (189 lines, generated by `prisma migrate diff` from the schema, with a header comment added).

**Applied to:** the disposable local PostgreSQL 16 inside the sprint container only (`clyntique_sprint`, `127.0.0.1:5433`). **Not applied** to `cyntique_demo` on Render (shared by Production and Preview), not to any Vercel environment. Applying it anywhere shared needs the CEO's explicit approval (see the integration plan).

**Timestamp:** `20261019190000` is later than the reviewer chat's `20261019180000_reviewer_chat`, so Prisma applies them in the order chat → lifecycle when both land. They touch different tables.

## Statement kinds in the migration (checked by `tests/migrations.test.ts`)
`CREATE TYPE` (6), `CREATE TABLE` (5), `CREATE INDEX` (new tables only), `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN` (ReviewCycle, two nullable columns), `ALTER TABLE … ADD CONSTRAINT` (foreign keys). **No** `DROP`, `RENAME`, `TRUNCATE`, `DELETE`, `UPDATE`, `ALTER COLUMN … TYPE`. No data backfill. Existing rows are untouched; new columns are nullable.

## New tables
| Table | Purpose | Key columns | FKs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AIScanRun` | One row per AI scan attempt, any outcome | `creativeId`, `versionId` (exact submitted version), `cycleId?`, `roundId?`, `initiatedById`, `status`, `modelUsed?`, `promptVersion?`, `summary`, `errorName?`, `extractedVisualText` JSON, `detectedClaims` JSON, `suggestedFindings` JSON (validated only), `discardedSuggestions`, `executionTimeMs?`, `createdAt` | creative/version CASCADE, cycle/round SET NULL, user RESTRICT. Index `(creativeId, createdAt)`, `(versionId)` |
| `AIScanRuleCheck` | Rule versions a scan evaluated | PK `(scanId, ruleVersionId)`, `ruleCode`, `ruleVersionNumber` (denormalised for history) | scan CASCADE, rule version **RESTRICT** |
| `ExternalSubmission` | A reviewed version sent to a platform or regulator (manual record) | `creativeId`, `versionId`, `cycleId?`, `destinationType`, `destinationName`, `platformCode?`, `marketCode?`, `submittedOn`, `externalReference?`, `note?`, `basis`, `recordedById`, `createdAt` | creative CASCADE, version **RESTRICT**, cycle SET NULL, platform/market RESTRICT, user RESTRICT |
| `ExternalOutcome` | What the platform/regulator answered (append-only) | `submissionId`, `kind`, `outcomeOn`, `note?`, `evidenceId?`, `basis`, `recordedById`, `createdAt` | submission CASCADE, evidence SET NULL, user RESTRICT |
| `PolicyRuleEvent` | Append-only rule history | `ruleId`, `versionId?`, `kind`, `actorId`, `note?`, `createdAt` | rule **RESTRICT**, version **RESTRICT**, user RESTRICT |

## Altered table
`ReviewCycle`: `+ reasonKind ReviewCycleReason?`, `+ triggerRuleVersionId String?` (FK to `PolicyRuleVersion`, **RESTRICT**). Cycle 1 of every existing submission keeps both as NULL.

Relation fields only (no columns) were added to `User`, `Creative`, `CreativeVersion`, `Evidence`, `SubmissionRound`, `Market`, `AdPlatform`, `PolicyRule`, `PolicyRuleVersion`.

## Why RESTRICT where it is
A rule version that a scan or a cycle cites, a user who recorded something, and a creative version that went to a regulator must not be deletable while the record exists. Scans and external rows follow their creative (CASCADE) because deleting a creative already deletes its whole review history today.

## Rollback
The migration is additive; rolling back is dropping the five tables, the two columns and the six types, in that order. No existing row would be affected. Prisma has no down migrations; the statements would be written by hand if ever needed.

## Verification performed
- `prisma migrate deploy` equivalent on the local DB (all migrations), then `prisma migrate status`: "Database schema is up to date!"
- `prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema`: empty (schema and database agree).
- Real-DB check (`scripts/db-check/lifecycle.db.test.ts`) exercised inserts into every new table and the RESTRICT/CASCADE behaviour on cleanup.
